label: Copilot Go-Live Score Report
section_hints: Include: the real Copilot go-live score (computed across governance, security, compliance, adoption, architecture, and licensing pillar data), pass/fail status against the go-live gate, and a one-line status per pillar. Follow with a single ranked list of findings ordered by point-impact to the score — not raw severity — citing the specific score increase each fix would produce. This is the front-door summary document: keep it tight and score-focused, not exhaustively detailed. Do not write runnable PowerShell or click-paths here.

label: Governance Posture Report
section_hints: Include: full governance-pillar findings — access reviews, group/role hygiene, retention and sensitivity label adoption, PIM/role assignment posture. Group by governance domain; for each finding give current state, why it matters, and severity.

label: Security Posture Report
section_hints: Include: full security-pillar findings — identity, Conditional Access, PIM, risky sign-ins/users, app consent and workload identity risk, SharePoint/OneDrive external sharing, mail security — plus Copilot-specific data exposure risk findings. Group by domain; for each finding give current state, why it matters, and severity.

label: Compliance & Regulatory Alignment Report
section_hints: Include: full compliance-pillar findings — DLP policies and violations, sensitivity/retention label coverage and errors, regulatory alignment gaps. Group by compliance domain; for each finding give current state, why it matters, and severity.

label: Licensing & Cost Optimization Report
section_hints: Include: full licensing- and cost-pillar findings — unused/unassigned licenses, license-gated feature requirements currently blocking Copilot readiness, cost optimization opportunities. For each finding give current state, financial/readiness impact, and recommendation.

label: Operational Health & Service Integrity Report
section_hints: Include: full operational-health findings — service health history, device/endpoint management posture, platform configuration drift. Group by domain; for each finding give current state and severity.

label: Adoption & Usage Report
section_hints: Include: full adoption-pillar findings — email/Teams/SharePoint/OneDrive/Viva Engage activity trends, overall active-usage rate. Describe current usage patterns and what they mean for Copilot rollout readiness.

label: Remediation Plan
section_hints: Cross-pillar, ranked by point-impact to the go-live score — same ranking basis as the Score Report, not raw severity. For each finding: current state, point-impact if fixed, and full self-serve remediation steps (PowerShell + Admin Center UI walkthrough) drawn from the verified remediation knowledge base where available, clearly labeled AI-generated guidance otherwise.

label: Statement of Work
section_hints:
Include: Scope of Work, Objectives, Deliverables, Timeline (phased), Resource Requirements, Pricing (see Tier 02 formula below), Acceptance Criteria (each criterion on its own line as
☐ criterion
), Terms & Conditions
